body:
okay this is the sweetest thing — taylor is just a fan too 🤍

on the tonight show, jimmy fallon asked her the last song she'd had on repeat, and she lit all the way up about someone else's: 'oh, tate mcrae has a great new song called "tit for tat," you gotta listen to it.' then — 'full volume, over and over again on repeat. it's just so good.'

and it wasn't a one-off. on siriusxm she named tate mcrae, sabrina carpenter and sombr as the three artists she's constantly streaming at home right now.

tate's been so open about what it meant to her — she's called it one of the coolest moments ever, the kind you facetime all your friends about.

there's something so lovely about the biggest pop star in the world still getting giddy over a song the way the rest of us do. tag the friend you'd text 'you HAVE to hear this' to 🤍

critique.rationale: Taylor gushing over another artist on Fallon ('tit for tat,' 'full volume, over and over again') plus her named streaming rotation — a warm, sourced, of-the-moment fan moment refreshed by Tate's own Fallon reaction today. IG tells the fuller story vs X's quote-led angle. Fan photo is a generic Eras tile, loosely tied.

why: Event draft for intake #5902 (Tate McRae on The Tonight Show, 'Talks Taylor Swift Shock', YouTube Jsb-nfZ2TbQ, oEmbed-verified). The real Taylor fact: on Fallon (Oct 6) she raved about Tate McRae's 'Tit For Tat' — verbatim quote confirmed by Billboard — and named Tate, Sabrina Carpenter & sombr as who she constantly streams (SiriusXM, via Billboard); Tate reacted with shock, refreshed by today's Fallon video. Photo is the run's reserved eventPhoto (uncredited u/unknown, so no credit line); IG uses the Instagram-sized ig45 variant of the same image as the X half (one pair, one photo). Share hook: tag-a-friend, grounded in the 'you gotta listen to it' quote.
